nodes.title: SUBJECT
nodes.summary: A historical study proposal outlining a critical review of literature on recording, analyzing, and interpreting bioelectric signals from the human body, and on activating human behavior by remote means. It provides an annotated bibliography and survey of psychophysiological research and instrumentation across five areas: electrical sensors and electrodes, recording (signal amplification, tape, multichannel recording), analysis (correlators, spectrum analyzers, data processing), standardization of data for correlation with biochemical, physiological, and behavioral measures, and remote activation techniques. Also mentions a consultant-based subproject for flexible funding.

Points: the survey was estimated at about $500,000 on a consultant basis; general agreement that it would be very useful.
